# Collected qiushuang-zhai references

Original photographs are retained without cropping or color changes. Attribution, license and original-byte checks are also recorded in `sources.json`.

## Slot 2

[qiushuang-entrance-plaque.jpg](qiushuang-entrance-plaque.jpg) — 朱華龍 - Zhu Hua Long, 2016-02-16 10:03.

Source: [大观园 Beijing, China (25435155793).jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%E5%A4%A7%E8%A7%82%E5%9B%AD_Beijing,_China_(25435155793).jpg). Photographer original: [Flickr](https://www.flickr.com/photos/mfaris01/25435155793/). License: [CC BY 2.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0).

SHA-256: `56483088ef591abccac076f8752aa79ac554ad3d3952d6ea9e0d276893be58c6`. Commons SHA-1: `61fd01f013045bfb05110f68d172b81c66a60d93`.

The visible plaque reads 秋爽齋 from right to left. The close entrance view shows a red structural frame, green rectangular return-pattern door lattices and a blue/turquoise/yellow painted upper beam and open fretwork. It supports the study hall frontage and patterned screen treatment; the cropped view does not establish the complete roof, plan, dimensions or the required night lighting.

These are design references, not shipped textures or measured source models. Unfilled reference slots remain open.
